tldr: Venus in the 7th house: love becomes personal through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
body:
With Venus in the 7th house, this part of you moves through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict. Venus describes love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, and what makes connection feel worth choosing. In practice, this brings attention to the one-to-one dynamics that show you how you meet others and how you let yourself be met.

When this placement is supported, relationship patterns can become clearer while there is still room to choose differently. Venus can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, and the ability to attract support.

When it is strained, you may hand too much power to the other person or make them carry the whole story. The harder pattern can show up as people-pleasing, avoidance, indulgence, or measuring worth through approval.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, and the ability to attract support expressed through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
challenge: people-pleasing, avoidance, indulgence, or measuring worth through approval around partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
